issues: The QTY (right-aligned) and REF (left-aligned) columns sit flush against each other, so '1.5 ltrTRF-808-2026-0065' runs together. Add padding (e.g. pl-4 on the Ref cells and header).

critical_code_review_comments: IngredientMovementReportPage: toISO uses toISOString(), which is UTC. For IST users between 00:00 and 05:30 'today' resolves to yesterday, so presets and max dates are off by one day. Use local date formatting.
IngredientMovementReportPage: PRESETS (today/daysAgo) is computed once when the module loads. If the tab stays open past midnight, the presets show stale dates. Compute them inside applyPreset.

ProductForm L532: the dropdown option 'Category Default (${product.stationName})' uses the same stationName that BUG-627 identified as the effective (possibly item-level) station, not the category's. When an item has a saved override, the option label may show the wrong station. Same root cause as BUG-627; consider using the category's station name.
IngredientMovementReportPage CSV export: cells are wrapped in quotes but embedded double quotes are not escaped.
action_items: Optional: add padding between the Qty and Ref columns in the CR-477 drill-down
Optional: switch to local-date helpers and compute presets lazily in CR-477
Optional: review the 'Category Default (stationName)' option label in ProductForm

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login takes about 20-60s to reach /dashboard (click 'Retry Failed' if it appears). Navigate in-app with history.pushState+popstate, or with expand-sidebar -> sidebar-reports -> sidebar-<child id>. Preprod API: POST /api/v1/auth/vendoremployee/common-login returns token. POST /api/v2/vendoremployee/inventory-transfer/ingredient-movement-report {movement,from_date,to_date}. POST /api/v2/vendoremployee/report/item-consumption-report {from_date,to_date}.
